# v1.14 cross-check fixture: reachability decided by the length bound (4095
# bytes). The solver's unbounded regex query is inconclusive on these rules
# (its models run past the bound); the derivative oracle and the procedure
# must agree on the bounded answer.
require warden 1.14
# The flags decide it: a read-only open of /d...d (4095 bytes) is shadowed,
# any other open is not.
deny path suffix d readonly
allow path 
# contains near the bound
deny path contains ddd/
allow path glob **
